decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication system sits close to the firm's established fluid-handling offer for machine-tool users and had its own page at launch, which signals visible commitment. The missing web evidence for 2020 and 2021 is more plausibly a pandemic-related lull than a failure, so management would persist.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's core filtration platform with its own engineering investment and a dedicated page. Weak COVID-era demand can be blamed on temporary causes, so dropping it would contradict the modular-platform strategy the firm has announced.

The gravity band coolant filter is central to the firm's core coolant filtration line and its in-house manufacturing. It was publicly presented on its own page, and it benefits from the industry's turnover growth, so management stays committed.
